- **Manifests for the vintage panel** (Track A). BLS does not publicly archive every vintage, so a lost panel cannot be fetched again. It would become: "A manifest of every CES vintage file used: source, retrieval date and checksum."
- **Source traceability for hand-built covariates** (Track B). The budget, staffing and sample figures come from hand-reading documents and cannot be checked otherwise. It would become: "Each hand-built figure traced to the document and page it came from."
- **A full validation suite** (both tracks). Your brief asks for these checks, and the core stages run only basic MCMC diagnostics. It would become: "Revision-size models checked against a constant-variance baseline by LOO/PSIS, by dispersion-targeted posterior predictive checks, and in pseudo-real time."
